exam.title: MongoDB Associate Atlas Administrator
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite is published. Practice designing, securing, monitoring, automating, scaling and recovering a small-to-medium single-region/single-provider Atlas environment. The detailed objectives require free enrollment; reconcile them with the current public 13-skill learning path before scheduling.

objective_coverage.objective_group: MongoDB Overview, CRUD, Data Transformation and Indexing
Networking Security and Encryption at Rest
Monitoring Tooling, Performance Tools and Techniques
Atlas administration through UI, CLI, API and managed configuration

review.notes: The 13 required skills in the current public 13-hour official path are treated as mappable public learning-path scope and covered through seven sections, three integrated operational scenarios, eight authorized labs and 40 original checks. MongoDB keeps the detailed objective body behind enrollment, and it could not be deterministically re-audited on September 7; the guide explicitly requires enrolled reconciliation and invents no weights. The current 70-question/95-minute contract, stale two-hour card, superseded path, August alignment, and AWS-specific limits of the added landing-zone lab are explicit. No recalled/live item, dump or copied course content is used.

public_learning_path_groups.title: MongoDB Overview
objectives: Understand the document model, dynamic schema, distributed architecture, and nested/semi-structured data.

public_learning_path_groups.title: CRUD Operations in MongoDB
objectives: Perform create, read, update, and delete operations.

public_learning_path_groups.title: Fundamentals of Data Transformation
objectives: Build aggregation pipelines to process, transform, and analyze data.

public_learning_path_groups.title: Indexing Design Fundamentals
objectives: Design indexes that improve supported queries and reduce resource consumption.

public_learning_path_groups.title: Query Optimization
objectives: Diagnose and improve slow or inefficient queries.

public_learning_path_groups.title: Sharding Strategies
objectives: Design, implement, and manage sharded clusters for scale and performance.

public_learning_path_groups.title: Monitoring Tooling
objectives: Use monitoring tools, interpret CPU/query metrics, and configure alerts.

public_learning_path_groups.title: Performance Tools and Techniques
objectives: Use profiling, slow-query analysis, index/cache evidence, and system metrics.

public_learning_path_groups.title: Data Resilience: Atlas
objectives: Design resilient Atlas deployments with failover, backups, security, compliance, and workload isolation.

public_learning_path_groups.title: Cluster Reliability
objectives: Diagnose and resolve replication, sharding, availability, and performance issues.

public_learning_path_groups.title: Secure MongoDB Atlas: Authentication and Authorization
objectives: Configure authentication and authorization for Atlas and database access.

public_learning_path_groups.title: Networking Security: Atlas
objectives: Use IP access lists, peering, private endpoints, and encryption in transit.

public_learning_path_groups.title: Encryption at Rest
objectives: Configure Atlas encryption at rest and customer-managed key integration where required.
